params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Caitlyn}} {{tip|basic attacks}} generate {{tip|stacks}} of ''Count'' {{tip|on-attack}}. At maximum stacks, her next basic attack will fire a ''Headshot'' dealing {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} that scales with her {{sti|{{as|critical strike chance}}}}.
params.blurb2: On {{ai|Yordle Snap Trap|Caitlyn|trapped}} or {{ai|90 Caliber Net|Caitlyn|netted}} targets, she gains another ''Headshot'' at extra {{sti|range|attack range}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Caitlyn's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Count'' {{tip|on-attack}}, doubled if she is within {{tip|brush}}. At 5 stacks, or 4 while in ''brush'', her next basic attack consumes all stacks {{tip|on-attack}} to become a ''Headshot''.
params.description2: {{sbc|Headshot:}} '''Caitlyn's''' basic attack is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and deal {{as|{{pp|key=%|60 to 80 for 3|1 to 13}}|ad}} {{as|(+ {{critical damage|0 to 80|critScaling=true}}) AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, increased to {{as|110% (+ {{critical damage|0 to 80|critScaling=true}}) AD}} against non-champions.
params.description3: Enemies that step over a ''{{ai|Yordle Snap Trap|Caitlyn}}'' or are hit by ''{{ai|90 Caliber Net|Caitlyn}}'' can grant an additional ''Headshot'' against them at {{sti|range|1300 range}} within {{fd|1.8}} seconds, without consuming stacks. Each method grants only one ''Headshot'' at a time.
params.notes:
* If '''Caitlyn's''' current target becomes trapped by {{ai|Yordle Snap Trap|Caitlyn}} or {{ai|90 Caliber Net|Caitlyn}} while her attack is on cooldown, this ongoing cooldown will be refunded partially so that her next attack on them can begin earlier.
** Swapping the target to an enemy trapped by {{ai|Yordle Snap Trap|Caitlyn}} or {{ai|90 Caliber Net|Caitlyn}} also reduces her ongoing attack cooldown.
*** {{pending for test}}: The exact attack cooldown refund appears to be 50% of the attack cooldown at current attack speed, but at a minimum amount it lets '''Caitlyn''' start the attack against the trapped target within {{fd|0.5}} seconds of her previous attack windup completing.
* The bonus range from {{ii|Rapid Firecannon}} will not have any effect during {{ai|Yordle Snap Trap|Caitlyn|trap}} and {{ai|90 Caliber Net|Caitlyn|net}} extended ''Headshot'' attacks.
* Only the ordinary {{as|100% attack damage}} portion of the attack can critically strike. The bonus from ''Headshot'' is added after the critical strike is rolled.
** The full damage of ''Headshot'' applies {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
** ''Headshot'' is a single instance of damage, thus does not trigger {{cais|Tantrum|Amumu}} or {{ii|Warden's Mail}} passives twice.
* Since '''Caitlyn's''' Art and Sustainability Update, Ability-granted ''Headshots'' are the same as the original ''Headshot'' override attack, though what lets them cast at high range is still relatively special. They trigger {{tip|on-attack}} effects (including stacking ''Headshot'').
** {{Pending for test}} {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nie|Wind's Fury}}, is special cased to search targets with the increased range as well.
* Because ''Headshot'' stacks are generated {{tip|on-attack}}, {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nies|Wind's Fury}} bolts will not generate any.
* The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|ward}}s.
** Stacks will still be generated towards ''Headshot'' when attacking them.

blurb.plain: Innate: Caitlyn basic attacks generate stacks of Count on-attack. At maximum stacks, her next basic attack will fire a Headshot dealing bonus physical damage that scales with her critical strike chance.

blurb2.plain: On trapped or netted targets, she gains another Headshot at extra attack range.

description.plain: Innate: Caitlyn's basic attacks generate a stack of Count on-attack, doubled if she is within brush. At 5 stacks, or 4 while in brush, her next basic attack consumes all stacks on-attack to become a Headshot.

description2.plain: Headshot: Caitlyn's basic attack is empowered to have an uncancellable windup and deal 60% / 70% / 80% (based on level) (+ 0% – 80% (+ Infinity Edge 0% – 32%) (based on critical strike chance)) AD bonus physical damage, increased to 110% (+ 0% – 80% (+ Infinity Edge 0% – 32%) (based on critical strike chance)) AD against non-champions.

description3.plain: Enemies that step over a Yordle Snap Trap or are hit by 90 Caliber Net can grant an additional Headshot against them at 1300 range within 1.8 seconds, without consuming stacks. Each method grants only one Headshot at a time.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Caitlyn}} revs up her rifle to unleash a penetrating shot that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
params.blurb2: The projectile expands after the first target but also deals less damage.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Caitlyn''' fires a piercing shot in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy it passes through, after which it expands in width but deals only 60% damage to enemies it hits thereafter.
params.description2: Enemies {{tip|true sight|revealed}} by ''{{ai|Yordle Snap Trap|Caitlyn}}'' always take {{ccs|full damage|physical}} from ''Piltover Peacemaker''.

blurb.plain: Active: Caitlyn revs up her rifle to unleash a penetrating shot that deals physical damage to enemies hit.

blurb2.plain: The projectile expands after the first target but also deals less damage.

description.plain: Active: Caitlyn fires a piercing shot in the target direction that deals physical damage to the first enemy it passes through, after which it expands in width but deals only 60% damage to enemies it hits thereafter.

description2.plain: Enemies revealed by Yordle Snap Trap always take full damage from Piltover Peacemaker.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Caitlyn}} sets a trap at the target location that lasts for a while. The trap springs when an enemy champion steps on it, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} and {{tip|root|rooting}} them.
params.blurb2: '''Caitlyn''' periodically [[ammunition|stocks]] a charge of ''Yordle Snap Trap'', up to a cap.
params.blurb3: The next ''{{ai|Headshot|Caitlyn}}'' against a trapped target will deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Caitlyn''' sets a visible trap at the target location that is {{tip|untargetable}} and arms after 1 second, lasting for a duration. The trap grants {{tip|sight}} of the area for 1 second after being placed.
params.description2: '''Caitlyn''' periodically [[ammunition|stocks]] a ''Yordle Snap Trap'' charge, up to a maximum amount. Deploying traps beyond the maximum destroys the oldest one.
params.description3: The next enemy champion that steps on the trap springs it, causing them to become {{tip|root|rooted}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds and {{tip|true sight|revealed}} for 3 seconds, as well as take additional damage from the ''{{ai|Headshot|Caitlyn}}'' granted by this ability. Trapped targets become immune to further ''Yordle Snap Traps'' for {{tt|3 seconds|Timer starts upon the target springing the trap}}, preventing them from springing subsequent traps for the duration.
params.notes: * Multiple armed traps on the same location will spring all at once if an enemy steps on one of them.
params.tips: * Check the scoreboard occasionally and aim to use ''Yordle Snap Trap'' on top of enemies who want to stay still during {{iis|Zhonya's Hourglass}} Time Stop or {{iis|Guardian Angel}} Rebirth, as the trap is guaranteed the moment they become targetable again.

blurb.plain: Active: Caitlyn sets a trap at the target location that lasts for a while. The trap springs when an enemy champion steps on it, revealing and rooting them.

blurb2.plain: Caitlyn periodically stocks a charge of Yordle Snap Trap, up to a cap.

blurb3.plain: The next Headshot against a trapped target will deal bonus physical damage.

description.plain: Active: Caitlyn sets a visible trap at the target location that is untargetable and arms after 1 second, lasting for a duration. The trap grants sight of the area for 1 second after being placed.

description2.plain: Caitlyn periodically stocks a Yordle Snap Trap charge, up to a maximum amount. Deploying traps beyond the maximum destroys the oldest one.

description3.plain: The next enemy champion that steps on the trap springs it, causing them to become rooted for 1.5 seconds and revealed for 3 seconds, as well as take additional damage from the Headshot granted by this ability. Trapped targets become immune to further Yordle Snap Traps for 3 seconds, preventing them from springing subsequent traps for the duration.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Caitlyn}} fires a heavy net that {{tip|slow|slows}} the first target hit and deals {{as|magic damage}} to them.
params.blurb2: Firing the net causes her to {{tip|dash|recoil}} back.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Caitlyn''' fires a net in the target direction and {{tip|dash|recoils}} 390 units in the opposite direction. The net deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 50% for 1 second.
params.description2: '''''Caitlyn''' will not recoil after the cast time if she was {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}} during it. She can cast any of her [[champion ability|abilities]] during the recoil dash.''

blurb.plain: Active: Caitlyn fires a heavy net that slows the first target hit and deals magic damage to them.

blurb2.plain: Firing the net causes her to recoil back.

description.plain: Active: Caitlyn fires a net in the target direction and recoils 390 units in the opposite direction. The net deals magic damage to the first enemy hit and slows them by 50% for 1 second.

description2.plain: Caitlyn will not recoil after the cast time if she was immobilized or grounded during it. She can cast any of her abilities during the recoil dash.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Caitlyn}} targets an enemy champion and takes time to line up the perfect shot, dealing massive {{as|physical damage}} to them at a huge range.
params.blurb2: The target's allied {{tip|champions}} can intercept the shot for them.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Caitlyn''' locks onto the target enemy champion and {{tip|channel|channels}} for 1 second, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them as well as {{tip|sight|revealing}} herself.
params.description2: ''Ace in the Hole'' is placed on a 5-second {{sti|cooldown}} if canceled.
params.description3: Once '''Caitlyn''' completes the channel, she fires a homing bullet toward the target that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy champion it hits, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 30|critScaling=true}}.
params.notes:
* The following will cancel ''Ace in the Hole's'' channel (mana expenditure is not compensated):
** '''Caitlyn''' is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}.
** The target becomes {{tip|untargetable}}.
** '''Caitlyn''' or her target {{tip|death|dies}}.
* ''Ace in the Hole'' reveals the target and '''Caitlyn''' through a buff that lasts for up to 4 seconds.
** The buff is applied to the target from the start of the cast time.
** The buff ends prematurely when the channel is canceled or the bullet hits an enemy.
*** The target is revealed for 1 second if the buff is ended prematurely.
*** It is not removed if the cast time is cancelled or the bullet missile is destroyed.{{bug|2}}
* The bullet missile will fail to hit the primary target if they are {{tip|untargetable}} upon arrival, dealing no damage.
* The ability also goes on a 5-second {{sti|cooldown}} if '''Caitlyn''' enters {{tip|resurrection}} during the cast time.
** The cast time does not end prematurely but the channel will be immediately canceled the moment the cast time completes.
* If the target dies after the bullet has been fired, the shot will continue towards their corpse and may still hit other enemy champions.
* The bullet has a {{tip|sight}} radius of 1500 attached to it.
{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}** This excludes losing sight of the target.
